title: refactor(app-shell): move ObjectView's renderListView into a sibling hook (slice 11a)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9VtKf3F9dzJPJM4RRtABaEc)_

Part of #25992 (slice 11a of the move-only split; slices 1 to 10 landed as #26152, #26233, #26310, #26336, #26353, #26374, #26396, #26412 and #26434). Slice 11 is split in two, as the seat agreed: this PR moves `renderListView`, and slice 11b (the view-config and view-tab CRUD handlers) closes the card.

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## What moved

Base `8cac64f2` (slice 10 merged). `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/ObjectView.tsx` is 2263 lines there. Three blocks of `ObjectViewInner` move verbatim into one custom hook, `useObjectViewListRenderer`, in the new sibling module `objectViewListRenderer.tsx`. Every input is passed as an argument, typed from its source (no `any`), and the component destructures `renderListView` under its original name. No identifier is renamed and no context is added.

- **O: `renderListView`** (lines 1145–1910). The `useCallback` the plugin `ObjectView` calls to draw a view. It covers the `type: 'chart'` face through `ObjectChart`, the `ListView` face with the relay of the view's keys onto `fullSchema`, the toolbar doors that write the user's own list state through `listPrefs.patchView`, the held `options` and `filter` identities, and the dependency list, all kept verbatim.
- **G-columns: the column-declaration flags** (lines 783–806). `activeTabDeclaresColumns`, `draftColumnsEdited`, `activeViewDeclaresColumns` and `activeViewIsSaved`, with their docblocks. Only `renderListView` reads them.
- **M: the held list identity refs** (lines 1109–1119). `heldListOptions` and `heldListFilter`, the two `useRef`s with their docblocks (objectui#10046, #7237). Only `renderListView` reads them.

The hook is called where `renderListView` stood, after the view tab bar hook. The block it returns is unchanged.

**Hook order.** The two `useRef` calls of M used to run before `useObjectViewTabBar` (whose `useViewTabsFit` and `useDisplayLocale` run in between). They now run after it, inside the new hook. Both are independent refs initialised to `undefined`; nothing between their old and new positions reads them. The seat's ruling allows this shift when stated. G-columns are plain values, not hooks.

The module also takes the lazy `ObjectChart` declaration (`lazy(() => import('@object-ui/plugin-charts')…)`), verbatim. Its only mount is the chart face of `renderListView`, so the chart chunk stays lazy and is split exactly as before. The `ImportWizard` lazy declaration stays in `ObjectView.tsx`.

### Imports

Each import moves with its only readers: `DENSITY_MODE_TO_ROW_HEIGHT`, `normalizeListViewSchema`, `buildListFilterKey`, `writeListFilterState`, `ListViewPreference`, `ListView`, `ListViewSchema`, `TreeViewConfig`, `useRef`, `ReactNode`, `resolveManagedByEmptyState`, `warnSuppressedListNav`, `substituteFilterTokens`, `keepInlineEditModeForTheSession`, and the view-options family entries (`timelineViewOptions`, `calendarViewOptions`, `ganttViewOptions`, `galleryViewOptions`, `kanbanViewOptions`, `storedLegacyOptions`, `isSameOptionsValue`). The view-options names are still re-exported from `ObjectView.tsx`, lines unchanged. Names the component still reads elsewhere (`useCallback`, `Suspense`, `lazy`, `isSavedViewId`, `FilterTokenScope`) are imported by the module as well. Nothing new is exported from `ObjectView.tsx`, and the package entry is untouched. `ObjectView.tsx` goes from 2263 to 1480 lines.

Move-only proof: the multiset of non-blank lines of the base `ObjectView.tsx` is contained in new `ObjectView.tsx` plus the module. The only base lines missing are six import lines or entries that lost a moved name: the `react`, `@object-ui/core`, `../context/ListPreferencesProvider.js`, `@object-ui/types` and `./objectViewChrome.js` imports, and the `substituteFilterTokens` entry of the helpers list. Each import is replaced by its trimmed form. Removed outright are the `./listFilterStorage.js`, `@object-ui/plugin-list`, `../utils/managedByEmptyState.js` and `../utils/warnSuppressedListNav.js` imports, the `ObjectChart` lazy declaration, and the view-options entries of the `./objectViewOptions.js` import list. Their lines reappear verbatim in the module. The added lines are the trimmed imports and the new import, the module header and imports, the hook signature and parameter types, the `return`, and in `ObjectView.tsx` the call with its destructuring and two-line comment.

## Test edits

Six source-scan readers move to the file that now holds what they read. Each edit is a path or file-list change, and no assertion changed:

1. `ObjectView.relayRungCensus-7559.test.ts`: `RELAY_SOURCE` reads `objectViewListRenderer.tsx` (both candidate paths), the parse name follows, and so does the path in the anchor's error message. The census anchors on `const fullSchema = { … }` in `renderListView`.
2. `packages/types/src/__tests__/tree-view-config-readers-8253.test.ts`: `CONSOLE_COMPOSITION` → `packages/app-shell/src/views/objectViewListRenderer.tsx`. It reads the `viewDef` tree `labelField` rung.
3. `packages/types/src/__tests__/object-view-unmirrored-keys-7779.test.ts`: `APP_SHELL_OBJECT_VIEW` → `packages/app-shell/src/views/objectViewListRenderer.tsx`. Its three reads are the app-shell relay (`rowHeight` through the fold, `rowColor`, and the absent `allowExport` / `prefixField` / `densityMode` reads).
4. `ObjectView.titleFieldConvergence.test.tsx`: the joined `SOURCE` list `['ObjectView.tsx', 'objectViewOptions.ts']` gains `'objectViewListRenderer.tsx'`. The seams it counts span all three.
5. `ObjectView.overlayPatchOnly.test.ts`: `objectViewCode` reads `ObjectView.tsx` and `objectViewListRenderer.tsx` joined. The retired-family absence covers both, `handleViewConfigSave` stays in `ObjectView.tsx`, and the objectui#12474 doors (`onDensityChange`, `persistHiddenFields`) are in the module.
6. `view-filter-fold.ratchet.test.ts`: `objectViewSrc` reads `ObjectView.tsx` and `objectViewListRenderer.tsx` joined. The `onFilterChange` handlers are in the module, and `handleViewConfigSave` stays in `ObjectView.tsx`.

Slice 11b will add its module to the joined lists in 5 and 6, and re-point the `writeRefusalCensus-11583` rows and `check-i18n-call-site-keys`.

## Seam table rows this PR changes (measured on `8cac64f2`)

## Verification

See the os-dev-report comment on the card for the full readings: app-shell `type-check` after rebuilding its dependency closure, every `ObjectView.*` test in `views/` (the calendar, gallery, gantt, timeline, kanban and chart bindings, relays, density, column and filter tests among them), the `AppContent*` tests, every other test that reads `ObjectView.tsx` as source, including the six re-pointed ones, eslint on the touched files, the derived dispatch gates, and a Console build.

## Acceptance notes

- eslint: 0 errors, no new `no-explicit-any`. The two files report 108 warnings against 107 for the base `ObjectView.tsx` alone. The one added warning is `react-refresh/only-export-components` on `objectViewListRenderer.tsx`: the module declares the lazy `ObjectChart` component and exports a hook. The declaration is kept verbatim with its only mount rather than reshaped. The two `exhaustive-deps` warnings on `handleViewChange` only moved lines. The six test edits add no warning.

Changeset: `.changeset/25992-objectview-list-renderer-split.md` (patch, `@object-ui/app-shell`).
